notes: New: Listen has a Reciter choice: Yasser Al-Dossary (default), Yasser Salamah, Mishary Alafasy or Fares Abbad.
Fix: the high-pitched ticking heard in some of Yasser Al-Dossary's audio files (Taha 47-135 and others) is filtered out.
New: About > Updates can follow Beta versions (every update); unticked, Meddeb offers only the stable versions.
New: press the microphone while the speech model is still loading: Meddeb listens at once and catches up once ready.
Change: updates download much less, and the speech model and reciters' audio are kept in Android's cache.
Change: Review: a failed card comes back after 45 min; cards on neighbouring ayat are one card; new button order.
New: Listen shows how long the range plays; pause between plays 6 s, a 3 s fade-out; Review's play follows Repeat.
Change: the alarm threshold is a slider with precision and recall; Optimize sits under the speech model.
Change: the bar reads search, microphone, next ayah, next word; hint buttons turn pale green when a press counts as read.
Change: wider messages with an X; Blind's empty ayah sign; Stats and Progress reordered; Al-Fatiha leaves the Manzil.
Change: Listen's row now sits above the Recite row, which stays whole; the cards button or the microphone hides it.
Change: after a Review card's result, the speaker opens Listen on that card's passage; the card row has no play button.
Change: a card's menu has Bury until tomorrow and Previous card; Suspend is gone. The card's close button is leftmost.
Change: Listen's plays are x1, x3, x5, x11, x19 or x40; Oldest page plays your whole run of recited pages once.
Fix: an update now installs while Listen is paused or stopped.
Fix: a card left 10 minutes without recitation starts again instead of being marked wrong.
Fix: after a card, Next word goes on from where you were; switching to Review no longer opens the session summary.
Change: due cards close to each other are merged into one card for the day; the help's ? is lit while it is open.
Change: a new Next word icon.
